# Draftava 1.2.2
This release makes workspace saving and recovery safer when files are synced or changed outside Draftava.
- Preserves recoverable copies when Draftava detects stale iCloud file-version conflicts. - Protects externally changed draft Markdown before Draftava saves over it. - Blocks saves while unresolved managed-file conflicts remain. - Keeps a bounded history of conflict-recovery packages. - Fixes unnecessary workspace revisions being written during an untouched app launch.
